text:
olivia: Hey folks — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/8421. Small routing change: split traffic by model-variant selector so we can route heavy prompts to low-latency model and cheap bursts to quantized variant. Need cross-team quick-eyes.

olivia: Files: orch/router.go, svc/config/variant_policy.yaml, infra/autoscaler.tf. Risk: incorrect variant mapping could send large batches to quantized model with no KV warming. Impact: transient latency spike.

olivia: Asks: runtime — verify kernel/kv-warm compatibility; platform — canary rollout orchestration and telemetry hooks; infra — autoscaler delta sanity check; security — quick look at auth header ordering and KMS usage in infra change.

sam: @olivia I can take runtime. Quick skim now, will post results in ~20m :eyes: \n
devon: I can handle platform canary plan. What's the desired rollout window?

olivia: ideally tomorrow 9am PT canary start, 2h ramp. If infra needs more lead time we can push.

lee: infra-bot: terraform plan ran, shows additional IAM binding for kms:Decrypt on infra/kms/key-ids. tagging infra-security for review.

nina-security: @lee @olivia I'll check the KMS change and the header reordering. Quick Q: are we adding service account with broad project-level access?

olivia: no, key restricted to model-serving-sa only, added explicit resource-level binding in the tf. snippet:

olivia: ```hcl
resource "google_kms_secret" "model_key" {
  name = "model-serving-key"
  project = "redwood-prod"
  members = ["serviceAccount:model-serving-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
}
```

sam: runtime quick notes: router.go change looks fine, but need an explicit kv-warm path when variant switches mid-request. I'll add a small patch to create a warming token. Will open a PR against your branch.

devon: platform plan OK. I'll add telemetry tags: route.variant and route.ramp_percent. Also add fallback policy for 50% of errors to force old routing.

nina-security: KMS change ok from my side, only ask is to scope the SA key usage to decrypt-only and rotate every 30 days. Also confirm header ordering patch — please add an integration test that validates auth header precedence.

olivia: noted, thanks. infra-bot: can you hold merge until runtime + security post LGTM? we want to avoid partial rollouts.

infra-bot: Merge gate: hold (runtime_pending, security_pending). CI: all green except flaky perf test — investigating.

lee: infra has no autoscaler conflict but recommend a 5% initial traffic cap until warm-up flows confirm.

olivia: OK — updated variant_policy.yaml to {"initial_ramp":5}. I'll update the PR description. Can everyone add their +1 here once you have real LGTM? :pray:

sam: +1 (runtime) — will post small warming patch shortly.

devon: +1 (platform) — canary scheduled tomorrow 09:00 PT.

nina-security: +1 (security) assuming rotation plan added before merge.

olivia: thanks all. tagging @sre for visibility.

sre-bot: Notified channel eng-sre for canary monitoring.

olivia: leaving a checklist in PR: runtime-warm, platform-telemetry, infra-iam-scoped, security-rotation, canary-window. Will follow up on the warming PR.

sam: PR link again for others: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/8421 — ping me for runtime details.

devon: noted, thanks.

(reacts: :thumbsup: from devon, sam, nina-security)
